title: Time Travel
text: “I’ll listen.”

An envoy from Siltvelt… I believe that’s a nation primarily composed of Demi-Humans, isn’t it? I’ve heard that they’ve been at odds with Melromarc for many years. Still, you say there’s a story? What kind of story is it? Even I don’t know everything about the future. There are many gaps in my memory, so I can’t make a judgment without hearing it first.
“Yes. I’d like the Spear Hero to hear this as well. I humbly request that you and the Shield Hero come to our country.”

Here’s what he said. This envoy is a representative from Siltvelt who had heard about the Summoning of the Four Holy Heroes and had come to the area… and apparently, he’s here to retrieve his Father, who is being persecuted in Melromarc.

“That’s the story, anyway… We’ve been making some progress leveling up, and since we’re leaving the country soon anyway, I think it might be a good idea. What do you think? It seems he’s already at a decent level…”
“Hmm…”

Although we’ve primarily been active in Melromarc, going to another country isn’t a bad choice. However, I have a dream of becoming Filo-tan’s owner. My father-in-law probably bought Filo-tan from a slave trader in Melromarc… If Filo-tan isn’t born from the Filolial-sama that hatches today, we’ll need to keep trying a little longer.
“The Shield Hero has also said we should wait to hear the Spear Hero’s opinion first. Please…”
“I understand.”
It’s true that this country would be tough on my father-in-law. But I have far too many things I must do in this country.
“Well then…”
“Father, I’ll miss you, but I’m looking forward to seeing how you do in Siltvelt.”
At my words, my father nodded as if convinced.
“…You’re right. I can’t keep relying on Motoyasu-kun forever. Since this is a good opportunity, I’ll go.”
“Then, Shield Hero…”
“Yeah. Could I accept this offer to go to Siltvelt?”
“Yes! Spear Hero! Thank you so much.”
“Don’t mention it—this, too, is a once-in-a-lifetime encounter.”
“Kuro-chan…”
“Gua?”
My Father is waving at Kuro-chan, who’s peeking into the room from outside the inn’s door.
“It’s better to stay with Motoyasu, isn’t it?”
“…Gua!”

After glancing back and forth between me and my Father a few times as if hesitating, Kuro-chan nodded. And then… the carriage prepared by the envoy from Siltvelt arrived, and my Father climbed aboard.
“Will you be all right financially?”
“No problem at all. We will provide whatever funds the Shield Hero requires.”
The envoy replied to my question in a polite tone.
“Motoyasu, thank you for everything so far. If you ever come to Siltvelt, be sure to stop by and say hello. We’ll welcome you with open arms.”
“Understood. As soon as I achieve my goal, I’ll rush right over to see you, Father.”
“U-uh-huh. Thanks to you, Motoyasu, you saved me from going completely mad. So…”
My Father nodded deeply, leaned out of the moving carriage, and waved as he called out.
“Thank you!　It’s a tough world out there, but I’ll do my best! I’ll definitely repay this favor!”
“Let’s meet again!”

Kuro-chan and I waved as we saw my Father off. Thinking about what the future holds, I’m sure he’ll be able to fight under better conditions and be happier here than if he’d kept fighting in this country.
Alright! I still have work to do! I have a mission to fulfill: to become Filo-tan’s master.
It was two days later.
“Moto… Kuro, I want to run more!”

Kuro-chan has taken on the form of an angel and started helping me train the new Filolial-sama. However, since Kuro-chan has to stay in a safe place while I fight, high-level hunting grounds are a bit tricky. Thanks to her speed, there are almost no places left in Melromarc she can’t reach on foot. Maybe I should start thinking about buying a carriage.
“Are we buying new eggs again today?”
“That’s right.”
“We can form a herd already!”
“Not quite yet.”
There are at least seven Filolial-sama in total. But only four have become angels, with Kuro-chan leading the way… We’re still far from enough!
“Once we buy the eggs, let’s run around and defeat monsters!”
“That’s right! We mustn’t forget to defeat the bandits.”

After that, I’ll assess the situation and head to another country to perform Class Up on Kuro-chan and the others. Just as I was thinking that—swords, spears, bows, and shields… four icons appeared in my field of vision. Then, one of them—the shield—lit up red.
“Moto—”
Suddenly, Kuro-chan… no, the whole world turned gray and froze.
“Huh?”

I reached out toward Kuro-chan. It seemed as if she had… frozen solid. The next instant, the spear began to rattle, and an analog clock appeared in my field of vision, its minute hand starting to wind back in reverse.
“Oh…”
When I looked ahead, I saw men in robes staring at me in astonishment.
“What’s going on?”
“Huh?”
That phrase… sounds familiar.
“Where are we?”
Ren is speaking to the castle’s wizard. Looking around, I see a familiar scene from the day we were summoned… the exact same scene from the third time was being projected right before my eyes.
“Oh, Heroes! Please save this world!”

My Father, Ren, and Itsuki all said this at the exact same time, in an identical situation. …What on earth is going on? It seems I’ve been sent back to the very moment I was summoned again. The situation hasn’t changed at all. Kuro-chan, whom I’d been raising… must have turned back into an egg, I suppose.
Ah… but memories I couldn’t recall last time are coming back to me now. Things like how to enhance weapons. Yeah, I should be able to make my Father and the others stronger than before.
But… why did I end up back here? I can’t think of any reason. Still, the best thing to do is just give it a try.
“Itsuki-kun”
“What is it? Wait, how do you even know my name—”
“Revenge for setting my Father up! Brionac X!”
“Eh…? Guh—!?”
I poured all my strength into my spear and unleashed the Skills on Itsuki. Even though he’s a hero, Itsuki is, after all, only Level 1—he didn’t even have time to dodge before he was reduced to dust.
“W-what are you—”

My father-in-law is speechless. Don’t worry! I, Motoyasu, will never harm you, no matter what happens! This time, the bow icon lit up red. Once again, a clattering sound echoed, and time began to rewind.
“Oh…”
When I looked ahead, the men in robes were staring at me in stunned silence. This is the second time.
“What’s going on?”
“Huh?”

Itsuki, the Itsuki I’d just taken down, was looking around, unable to grasp what was happening. There’s no doubt about it. I’ll double-check, just to be safe. It’s what you might call “killing two birds with one stone.”
“Ren-kun”
“Hm? What is it?”
“Meteor Thrust X!”
“Whoa!”
With that daft cry, I blew holes all over Ren’s body. This time, the sword icon lit up red. Immediately afterward, I confirmed the same phenomenon as before.
“Whoa…”
When I looked ahead, I saw men in robes staring at me in stunned silence. This is the third time.
“What’s up?”
“What’s that?”

As I suspected… it seems the Minute Hand of the Dragon Hourglass—the one that’s activated when the hero dies—has the effect of rewinding time. So this is the ability, Time Reversal… and the “Branching Worlds” special effect? Moreover, thanks to my body getting used to the time reversals, I’ve been able to recall quite a bit. Presumably, that red icon is a signal that someone has died. In other words, my Father, whom I parted ways with, must have died for some reason.

This is a blunder I’ll regret for the rest of my life, Motoyasu. To be unable to stand by the one to whom I owed my loyalty in his hour of crisis! It seems that, given the circumstances, what I must do—what I must do to meet Filo-tan—is to protect my Father. Fortunately, I’ve figured out how the loop works.
If my involvement as Motoyasu can change the situation, then I’ll show you that I can bring about a better future.
That concludes the Tutorial Arc. Starting with the next episode, we’ll move on to the Siltvelt Arc.
